mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 56 degrees under mainly clear skies at the Verona Area High School, with the moon currently in a waning gibbous phase.

In city news, please be advised that alternate-side winter parking regulations begin November 20. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat taking place today at Hometown Junction Park. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow at the Capitol Square, or enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2.

In our weekly look at local safety, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, leading to citations for their parents for allowing the minors to operate the vehicles.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM tonight.
